issues.explanation: The invite form shows @error for inviteRole but no @error for inviteEmail, so the required exactly-once invite e-mail error is not evident in the diff.
Server-context IDs/flags should be #[Locked] but are plain public properties, leaving tampering to be caught only by later scoped lookups.
Closing the removal modal changes UI state without a server-side authorization check, unlike every other manager action in the component.
Component validates with two validateOnly calls instead of the project pattern #[Validate] plus $this->validate().
Two new CI/deploy workflow files are unrelated to invite-only membership and should be a separate change.
